prompt: An organization wants its payment-team runners usable only by payment-team repositories. Which mechanism does that?
explanation: Runner groups are the policy boundary: create a group, register the runners into it, and scope which repositories — or teams — may use it. Labels route jobs; groups decide who is allowed to route jobs there at all.

options.text: Runner labels named after the repositories
A runner group with access restricted to selected repositories
An IP allow list on the runners
